instruction: Extract the project context, objective, actors, scope, constraints, assumptions, and missing information from the stakeholder input.
input: Project brief for AssetInk Endorsement Trail: The objective is to review requests to correct insured-asset descriptions and control when accepted corrections become effective. Policyholders request corrections and provide proposed corrected details. Policy Service Agents check supporting evidence and return incomplete requests. Underwriting Reviewers record whether corrections are accepted or rejected and whether premium review is required. Policy Records Clerks update accepted asset descriptions and record effective dates. Requests requiring premium review stay open until the review is recorded. Collecting premium payments and issuing refunds are outside the project. The evidence required for each correction type and the role that performs premium review are not yet defined.

output.business_objective: Review requests to correct insured-asset descriptions and control when accepted corrections become effective.
